posts.zh:
secret-guard 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。拦截 agent 对敏感文件（.env、凭据、密钥材料）的读写，对工具结果中泄露的机密形状内容做掩码兜底，记录审计日志，并提供永不输出原始值的 sg_* 安全检查工具。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0f179403efc4cb950a64.html
posts.en:
secret-guard is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Blocks agents from reading or writing sensitive files (.env, credentials, key material), masks leaked secret-shaped values in tool results, keeps an audit journal, and exposes safe sg_* inspection tools that never print raw values.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0f179403efc4cb950a64.html
